description: Machine-readable state contract for the TTrades fractal model. This file is the single source of truth for path families, POI ontology, stage transitions, invalidations, and entry-ready constraints.

continuation.description: Directional continuation after higher-timeframe bias is established.

transition_conditions: No valid continuation thesis is present.
Upgrade to c2 when an aligned ITF POI becomes valid.
c1.fallback_behavior: If HTF bias is lost, return to none.

required_evidence: An aligned ITF POI is tagged inside the HTF directional thesis.
transition_conditions: Upgrade to c3 on ITF/LTF confirmation such as closure, CISD, or protected-swing confirmation.
c2.fallback_behavior: If POI invalidates before confirmation, return to c1 or none depending on HTF bias.

required_evidence: ITF or LTF confirmation has occurred.
Protected swing or closure evidence supports continuation.
transition_conditions: Upgrade to c4 when confirmation, POI validity, and directional alignment indicate entry-ready structure.
c3.fallback_behavior: If confirmation fails or invalidates, return to c1 or c2.

transition_conditions: Remain in c4 while invalidation is intact and no disqualifying session rule applies.
c4.fallback_behavior: If invalidation breaks, downgrade to c3 or none.

invalidation_conditions: The protected swing breaks against the thesis.
POI is invalidated before or immediately after confirmation.

reversal.description: Reversal path after liquidity interaction or external objective sweep changes directional context.

transition_conditions: No valid reversal context is present.

required_evidence: Liquidity sweep or external objective interaction creates reversal context.
transition_conditions: Upgrade to c2 when reclaim/return validates a reversal POI.
c1.fallback_behavior: If sweep context resolves without reclaim, return to none.

required_evidence: Reclaim or return through the swept area has occurred.
transition_conditions: Upgrade to c3 when reversal confirmation occurs through closure, CISD, or protected-swing change.
c2.fallback_behavior: If reclaim fails, return to c1 or none.

required_evidence: Directional change is supported by local structure.
transition_conditions: Upgrade to c4 when reversal confirmation, POI validity, and directional alignment indicate entry-ready structure.
c3.fallback_behavior: If confirmation is lost, return to c1 or c2.

transition_conditions: Remain in c4 while invalidation is intact and no disqualifying session rule applies.
c4.fallback_behavior: If invalidation breaks, downgrade to c3 or none.

invalidation_conditions: Reclaim fails and price accepts back through the swept area.
Protected swing re-breaks against the reversal thesis.
POI is invalidated before entry readiness.

default_entry_ready_constraints: htf_bias must be directional and aligned
